modifications.description: Initial accommodation research for 15-day China trip: Beijing (Saga Hostel + Leo Hostel), Datong (City Comfort Inn), Chengdu (Mix Hostel), Xi'an (Shuyuan Hostel), Shanghai (Captain Hostel)
Initial entertainment research for 15-day China trip (Beijing, Datong, Chengdu, Xi'an, Shanghai) - added evening activities for 13 of 15 days

Added inter-city transportation for all location change days: Day 3 (Beijing->Datong HSR), Day 4 (Datong->Beijing HSR return), Day 5 (Matilde: Beijing->Chengdu flight), Day 6 (Jade: Beijing->Chengdu flight), Day 8 (Jade: Chengdu->Beijing flight), Day 9 (Chengdu->Xian HSR), Day 12 (Matilde: Xian->Shanghai flight; Jade: Beijing->Shanghai flight), Day 14 (Shanghai->Beijing HSR)

Added shopping POIs for 15-day China trip: Qianmen/Dashilar (Day 1 Beijing), Weidu Antique City (Day 4 Datong), Jinli Ancient Street (Day 5 Chengdu), Kuanzhai Xiangzi (Day 7 Chengdu), Muslim Quarter (Day 10 Xi'an), Shuyuan Men (Day 11 Xi'an), Yu Garden Bazaar + Tianzifang + Nanjing Road area (Day 13 Shanghai), Wangfujing (Day 14 Beijing)
Added attractions for all 15 days across Beijing, Datong, Chengdu, Xi'an, and Shanghai with GPS coordinates from Gaode Maps
Generated complete 15-day meal plan for Beijing, Datong, Chengdu, Xi'an, Shanghai with Gaode Maps verified restaurants including Day 14 Michelin dinner at Da Dong
Created full 15-day timeline with route optimization, semantic meal windows, accommodation refs, and travel segments

Initial budget calculation: daily breakdown per person in CNY, transport costs tracked separately, data quality warnings on underestimated attraction prices, optimization recommendations for Day 7/13/14
Replaced Beijing hostel with Jade's home (Wudaokou Ziroom Apartment) for all Beijing nights: Days 1, 2, 4, 14, 15. Cost set to 0 (free stay).
Day 1 Beijing: Removed Tongrentang traditional medicine (not tourist-relevant), added Daoxiangcun snack gift boxes and Nanluoguxiang craft shops. Kept Ruifuxiang silk and Dashilar souvenirs.

Day 1 Beijing meals refinement: replaced 老北京炸酱面 breakfast with 二友居西四包子铺 (user-requested), replaced 庆丰包子铺 lunch with 门框胡同百年卤煮总店 (authentic hutong local food), updated 四季民福 dinner notes with queue strategy and added 利群烤鸭店 as alternative

Day 1: Replaced all-walking plan with proper Beijing metro routes. Added Capital Airport Express+Line2 arrival route for Matilde, Daxing Airport alternative, Beijing South Station HSR option, Jade Wudaokou Line13+Line2 route, and Didi guidance for luggage/late-night

Added 2 morning attractions for Day 1 (2026-05-02 Beijing arrival day): Dongjiaominxiang Embassy Quarter citywalk (primary, 09:00-11:00, free) and Temple of Heaven morning walk (optional alternative). Both verified via RedNote.
Added 2 entertainment options for Day 1 (2026-05-02, Beijing): Laoshe Teahouse folk art show and TIAO hutong cocktail bar near Qianmen/Dashilar area

Day 1 morning replanned: replaced Xisi baozi breakfast with Tianxingju at Xianyukou (near Qianmen hotel), added VOYAGE COFFEE Yangmeichu and METAL HANDS Qianmen as hutong café options, added Yinsan Douzhir as alternative breakfast. Cafés verified via XHS (3269 likes) and Gaode Maps.
Added 3 shopping spots to Day 1 Beijing (Qianmen/Dashilar/Yangmeizhu Xiejie): Qiankun Space cultural creative shop, Qirunxiang Incense Studio, Ruifuxiang Silk Store

Recalculated Day 1 budget after meals.json update added breakfast (Tianxingju 32 CNY) and cafe (VOYAGE COFFEE 48 CNY). Also added entertainment costs from entertainment.json (Laoshe Teahouse 150 CNY). Total per person revised from 323 CNY to 617 CNY. 2-person daily total 1234 CNY exceeds 800 CNY ceiling.
Recalculate Day 1 timeline with morning attractions, cafe stop, proper lunch window clamping, dinner clamped to 18:00, Laoshe Teahouse evening, metro return to Wudaokou
Marked Laoshe Teahouse (Day 1) as optional=true; added skip note with free alternative: Yangmeizhu Xiejie hutong stroll
Replaced Day 2 breakfast primary from Fangzhuanchang noodles to Eryouju Xisi Baozi, a local neighborhood baozi institution in Xicheng near Xisi Metro
Day 2: Replaced public bus route (916/936) to Mutianyu Great Wall with Didi/taxi segments (going and return), plus full-day charter driver as alternative option
Replaced Day 2 dinner from 姚记炒肝店 to 南门涮肉(后海店) at Shichahai — traditional Beijing copper pot mutton hotpot, rating 4.8, verified via RedNote (1690 likes)

Recalculated Day 2 budget: Didi transport updated from 35 to 225 CNY/person (200-250 CNY round trip split 2), dinner updated to Nanmen Shabu-Shabu 105 CNY (was 29 CNY placeholder), accommodation corrected to 0 CNY (Jade's home). Day 2 total: 536 CNY/person, exceeds 400 CNY ceiling by 136 CNY (34% over)

Recalculate Day 2 timeline: updated transport to Didi/taxi (not bus), updated dinner to 南门涮肉 at Shichahai, corrected schedule to breakfast at 07:30, Great Wall 10:30-15:30, return 15:30, dinner 18:30, Houhai evening
Added Day 1 arrival travel segment: Capital Airport Express + Metro Line 2 to Qianmen (06:00-07:15), and corresponding timeline entry for Matilde's airport arrival journey
Day 3 Datong: Added Huayan Temple (华严寺), Prince Dai's Mansion (代王府), Shanhua Temple (善化寺, optional); fixed Yungang Grottoes ticket price from 10 to 120 CNY
Recalculated Day 3 (Datong) budget: added Huayan Temple (65 CNY) + Prince Dai Mansion (80 CNY) to activities, corrected Yungang at 120 CNY, updated transport to 238 CNY with city taxis

Recalculated Day 3 Datong timeline: added Huayan Temple, Prince Dai's Mansion, Shanhua Temple; adjusted Yungang to 11:30-13:30; fixed 0-duration travel_segment bug; used real Gaode Maps routing for taxi segments
Moved Yungang Grottoes from Day 3 to Day 4 morning (08:30-11:30); Day 3 now ancient city only (华严寺, 代王府, 善化寺, 古城墙)
Removed Yungang Grottoes (120 CNY) and Yungang taxi (60 CNY) from Day 3. City attractions only: Huayan Temple (65 CNY) + Prince Dai Mansion (80 CNY). Day 3 total reduced from 636 to 456 CNY/person.

Revised Day 3 timeline: removed Yungang Grottoes, rescheduled all attractions to ancient city only (华严寺 first at 11:30, then lunch, free time, 代王府 at 15:00, 善化寺 and 古城墙 optional). Updated travel segments with real Gaode Maps routing data.

Revised Day 4 timeline: Added Yungang Grottoes as morning activity (08:30-11:30), restructured full-day logistics with Yungang→Hanging Monastery taxi (~82km/90min), removed antique city shopping, updated travel segments with Gaode Maps routing data

Recalculated Day 4 budget: Yungang Grottoes (120 CNY) added back (moved from Day 3), Hanging Monastery actual ticket 130 CNY used, charter taxi model for Yungang-Monastery-Station route (250 CNY/person), dinner moved to Beijing (50 CNY), accommodation corrected to 0 CNY (back at Jade's home)
Replaced City Comfort Inn (generic chain) with 高渡精品酒店(大同古城华严寺店) - boutique hotel 4.7 stars, 722m from Huayan Temple, inside ancient city walls

Replaced all Day 4 meals with XHS-verified authentic local food: Datong breakfast (1949豆腐脑 local chain), Hunyuan lunch (鸿福酒楼 in Hunyuan county — correct location, not 71km away in Datong city), Beijing Wudaokou dinner (椒鸣椒麻小馆 from XHS university student picks list)

Replace all Day 3 (Datong 2026-05-04) meals with XHS-verified authentic local restaurants: breakfast at Liu Laolao Bean Noodles (4.7★), lunch at Xijindao Noodle House Huayan Temple branch (4.8★), dinner at Longjuxiang Shaomai Drum Tower branch (4.8★). All sourced from XHS local guide with 1178 likes.
Day 4 Datong: marked 悬空寺 as optional with ticket booking notes, added 应县木塔 as primary afternoon attraction, added 净土寺 as secondary afternoon attraction
Day 4 lunch replaced: Hunyuan 鸿福酒楼 → Yingxian 二女凉粉总部 (itinerary changed to Yingxian/应县木塔). Day 4 dinner replaced: 椒鸣椒麻小馆 → 很久以前羊肉串中关村店. Breakfast unchanged.

Recalculated Day 4 budget with updated costs: Yingxian Pagoda 48+Jingtu Temple 20 replace Hanging Monastery, lunch 16 CNY actual (Yingxian liangfen), breakfast 13 CNY, charter taxi midpoint 225, metro 6 CNY. Total 687 vs previous 822 CNY/person

Recalculate Day 4 timeline: replaced Hanging Monastery with Yingxian Wooden Pagoda + Jingtu Temple; updated lunch to Ernu Liangfen (Yingxian), dinner to Henjiuyiqian Beijing; all travel times verified via Gaode Maps API
Replaced Xi'an Days 9-11 hostel with Moxy Xi'an South (碑林太乙路) based on 小红书 research. Hotel: Marriott Moxy brand, ~275-304 CNY/night, 大众点评必住榜, near Bell Tower/City Wall.

Replaced Day 6 (2026-05-07 Chengdu/Leshan) meals: breakfast=老成都纸皮烧麦 near Chunxi, lunch=牛轰轰跷脚牛肉 in Leshan, dinner=万重锦人文川菜馆 for reunion dinner. All different from Day 5 restaurants. Primary source: Gaode Maps + RedNote 乐山美食推荐 verification.

Replaced Captain Hostel Shanghai (youth hostel) with Heishi M+ Hotel (上海黑石M+酒店) for Days 12-13 - boutique design hotel in historic 1924 Blackstone Apartment, French Concession, ~300-500 CNY/night, rednote-recommended

Replaced Day 9 Xi'an meals (arrival day from Chengdu): breakfast at 汤笼记 near Bell Tower, lunch at 马天小炒泡馍 (4.7★), dinner at 西安饭庄钟楼店 (4.6★ Shaanxi old brand). RedNote-verified local recommendations avoiding touristy Muslim Quarter.
Replaced Day 15 Beijing farewell meals: METAL HANDS hutong coffee breakfast, Xiao Diao Li Tang Beijing cuisine lunch, Da Dong Roast Duck farewell dinner

Replaced Day 14 (2026-05-15 Beijing) breakfast, lunch, and dinner with local-gem recommendations: Huguo Temple Snacks for breakfast, Xiaodiao Litang for lunch, Sijie Minfu Roast Duck near Forbidden City for dinner

Replace Day 11 Xi'an meals with unique last-day options: shuipan lamb breakfast near Bell Tower, Chunfasheng hulutou ICH lunch, Tang Mao Courtyard dinner at Da Tang Bu Ye Cheng adjacent to Da Yan Ta fountain
Day 8 Chengdu last-day meals: breakfast at 龙抄手(总店), lunch at 叶婆婆钵钵鸡(太古里店), farewell dinner at 荣乐园 (century Sichuan cuisine est. 1911). Matilde solo day — Jade returns to Beijing for class.
Replaced Days 5-8 Chengdu accommodation: Mix Hostel → Atour Hotel Wuhou Shrine (成都武侯祠宽窄巷子亚朵酒店), Jinli Zhong Road 18. Light luxury 4-star, 4.6 stars Gaode, 小红书 popular brand, ~250-450 CNY/night.
Replaced Day 7 (2026-05-08 Chengdu) meals with RedNote-verified local century-old restaurants: breakfast at Lai Tangyuan (1894), lunch at Daijang Caotang (1936), dinner at Rongleyuan (1911)

Replace Day 5 (2026-05-06, Chengdu) breakfast/lunch/dinner with local Chengdu restaurants: airport tantanmian for breakfast, Michelin Bib Gourmand Luji Zhengji for lunch, stylish Huadie Qianxun Sichuan banquet for dinner near Jinli Street

Replaced Day 12 Shanghai meals with locally-researched options: Xiao Yang Shengjianbao for breakfast (near Bund, rating 4.6), HOMES Shanghai Local Cuisine for lunch (French Concession, must-eat list, rating 4.6), and Waitan Jiayan at Bund 22 for reunion dinner (rating 4.8). All verified via Gaode Maps POI search.

Recalculated Day 8 timeline: updated accommodation from Mix Hostel to Atour Hotel Wuhou Shrine, fixed dinner/IFS overlap, adjusted Panda Base start time, added Gaode Maps-based travel segments

Recalculated Days 5-15 budget with updated accommodation (Atour/Moxy/Blackstone), new meals.json prices, and corrected attraction costs
